title: Sidebar: Inset
description: The page sits in a rounded panel on the sidebar's color, here a dashboard with a chart.
author: DressCode UI <https://dresscodeui.com>

"use client" // An inset sidebar: the page sits in a rounded panel on the sidebar's color, the layout of most // dashboards. Folding it (trigger, Ctrl/⌘ B) slides the nav away and the panel takes the full width; // the cards reflow on the panel's own width, not the window's. // It sits in a 640px frame here: in your app,
